FINAL SQL:
SELECT 
    MAX(total_deaths) AS max_death_toll,
    MIN(total_deaths) AS min_death_toll
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(d.killed + d.injured) AS total_deaths
    FROM death d
    JOIN ship s ON d.caused_by_ship_id = s.id
    JOIN battle b ON s.lost_in_battle = b.id
    GROUP BY b.id
);
